authors: Casalia B, Vilacoba E, Lavinia PD, Tubaro PL, Barreira AS
title: UV sensitive vision in cardinals and tanagers is ubiquitous
why: Partial SWS1 opsin sequences across Cardinalidae and Thraupidae; abstract says every species studied has the UV-type sequence. The abstract page does not say whether Paroaria is in the sample. A gene survey, so it gives a predicted pigment class only. Already wanted by sweep-10 for Thraupis.

title: Critical illumination and critical frequency for response to flickered light (J Gen Physiol; Anax junius larvae; title taken from the page address, authors and exact title unconfirmed)
why: Dragonfly larvae of Anax junius tested for flicker response across illumination; the page shows only an abstract with no numbers and the PDF is a scan. This is larval behaviour, so it would not by itself give the adult's flicker fusion.
